paragraphs.text: Tsukikage was a kitten out of the Nekoru Wasitora 's litter on Dominaria .

His name meant Moonshadow . Kolo Meha found this such a fitting name, that he didn't think of a nickname, making Tsukikage the only kitten who wasn't complaining about the names Meha thought up for them. Tsukikage was the smallest kitten. He was white with grey patches and the most delicate of the bunch.
